h1.cap: Waiting for the right moment? Rumi's lion has a question for you.

n2.cap: In the Masnavi, the animals offer a lion a deal... one of them each day, if he stops hunting.

n3.cap: He'd rather rely on his own effort. They say... relax.

q1.cap: "Lay aside caution... trust is the better part."

n4.cap: The lion concedes one point. True, he says... trust is the mainstay. But...

q2.cap: "Ye have feet — why then pretend ye are lame? Ye have hands — why then conceal your claws?"

n5.cap: In essence... the Creator sets a ladder at your feet. Climb to the roof... step by step.

n6.cap: And just waiting? He calls it sleeping on the road... among highwaymen.

n7.cap: The twist? The lion takes their deal anyway. Then the hare, the weakest of them, makes a plan... and outwits him.

n8.cap: Trust was never the problem. Trust with folded hands is. Like dreaming of the right job... and sending zero applications.

n9.cap: This morning, pick one thing you keep saying will work out... and take one step before noon. One email. One page. One call.

n10.cap: What are you still waiting on? One word, in the comments.

n11.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and climb one step today.
